findings.explanation: Lean proves `locnrow UNKNOWNpt = locnrow EOFpt` because both calls reduce to the same `ARB : Nat`. The saved HOL4 equation constrains only `POSN r c` and permits the two other constructors to have different row values.
findings.repair:
private opaque locnrowFallback : locn → Nat := fun _ => 0

noncomputable def locnrow : locn → Nat
  | .POSN r _ => r
  | p => locnrowFallback p
findings.lean_check:
import CmlTS.Location
open CmlTS
example : locnrow UNKNOWNpt = locnrow EOFpt := rfl

findings.explanation: For any `f` and `g`, Lean proves `locn_rowupdate f UNKNOWNpt = locn_rowupdate g EOFpt` because both calls reduce to the same `ARB : locn`. The saved HOL4 equation specifies updates only on `POSN r c`. On the other constructors it permits results to depend on both the function and the location.
findings.repair:
private opaque locnRowupdateFallback : (Nat → Nat) → locn → locn := fun _ p => p

noncomputable def locn_rowupdate (f : Nat → Nat) : locn → locn
  | .POSN r c => .POSN (f r) c
  | p => locnRowupdateFallback f p
findings.lean_check:
import CmlTS.Location
open CmlTS
example (f g : Nat → Nat) : locn_rowupdate f UNKNOWNpt = locn_rowupdate g EOFpt := rfl
